creatures.name: Mephit, Air
creatures.languages: Common, one appropriate elemental language (Aquan, Auran, Ignan, or Terran)
creatures.ac: 17, touch 14, flat-footed 14 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +3 natural, +1 size)
creatures.hp: 19 (3d10+3); fast healing 2 (works only in gusty and windy areas)
creatures.special_attacks: breath weapon (15-foot cone, 1d8 slashing damage, Reflex DC 13 for half)

spellcasting.text: (CL 6th) 1/day—summon (level 2, 1 mephit of the same type 25%), gust of wind; 1/hour—blur

creatures.description: This small humanoid creature has thin, leathery wings, small horns, and a mischievous smile.

special_abilities.name: Breath Weapon
special_abilities.description: Each type of mephit can unleash a particular breath weapon every 4 rounds as a standard action. The DC is Constitution-based and includes a +1 racial bonus. An air mephit's breath weapon is a cone of sand and grit that deals 1d8 slashing damage.

creatures.ecology:
Mephits are the servants of powerful elemental creatures. Key sites and locations on the elemental planes are full of mephits scurrying about on important errands or duties. Each mephit is associated with one element that defines its spells and abilities.

Air mephits are commonly found on the Plane of Air. These mephits are whimsical and prone to distraction.

creatures.name: Mephit, Dust
creatures.languages: Common, one appropriate elemental language (Aquan, Auran, Ignan, or Terran)
creatures.ac: 17, touch 14, flat-footed 14 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +3 natural, +1 size)
creatures.hp: 19 (3d10+3); fast healing 2 (works only in dusty environments)
creatures.special_attacks: breath weapon (15-foot cone, 1d4 slashing damage plus sickened, Reflex DC 13 for half and negates sickened)

spellcasting.text: (CL 6th) 1/day—summon (level 2, 1 mephit of the same type 25%), wind wall; 1/hour—blur

creatures.description: This small humanoid creature has thin, leathery wings, small horns, and a mischievous smile.

special_abilities.name: Breath Weapon
special_abilities.description: Each type of mephit can unleash a particular breath weapon every 4 rounds as a standard action. The DC is Constitution-based and includes a +1 racial bonus. A dust mephit's breath weapon is a cone of dust that deals 1d4 slashing damage. The dust also causes living creatures to be sickened for 3 rounds. A Reflex save halves the damage and negates the sickened effect.

creatures.ecology:
Mephits are the servants of powerful elemental creatures. Key sites and locations on the elemental planes are full of mephits scurrying about on important errands or duties. Each mephit is associated with one element that defines its spells and abilities.

Dust mephits are commonly found on the Plane of Air. These mephits are irritating and persistent.
